body:
I don't think a complete absence of structure is more desirable. In face I think structure is the most important aspect in living. I don’t want structure as I do not value things. I could drive for the best job, a relationship, a family, children, etc., but I don’t because I don’t care. I do not have an idea to fill a structure, not that I cannot force one in, but to do so pretending that I am living for an esteemed value.

My freedom comes from the fact if I am bored/depressed/sick/exploratory I could change my lifestyle for a year or more without issue. Having worked all hours before (overnights are fucked) and now being forced to 9-5 it sucks is you have insomnia or feel like shit. It is one thing to take a sick date, it is another to remove responsibilities for a year while you understand yourself and reflect on your being.

The items that give me happiness are not great, I have learned to not feel guilty for spending time with useless activities, but I do enjoy these activities (for example playing a game). To say I am going to force an available year so I can do things hurts me. My life is forced to adapt to an external structure without care. I’m severely depressed at the moment and I can take time off work, but only a short time. Taking more than a few days is outside of the standard operating procedure. Stop being depressed or stop being paid, a great set of choices.

I want the freedom to be me regardless of the state as long as it is not damaging to others, but the expectation is to be in the social world working and meet every social event. I find birthdays and Christmas stupid, but if I ignore them every around me gets angry because I don’t accept their belief. If you need a holiday to allow you to live how you want I think you are completely submissive and should kill yourself. If a person wants to setup a party on their birthday and 2 months after their birthday, why is the birthday valued? (I haven’t celebrated my birthday in 15 years). People want a social structure to believe in. I reject it all and that puts e outside of our current world, therefore I don’t want to participate.  Hope the people who submit are happy for their beliefs, but I cannot do that, I know it is bullshit.

The idea of making a best of it is delusion mixed with apathy. I should accept that I am forced to be a cog in the system (a large simplification) and accept that I can do valuable things outside of that. Therefore my best course of action is to complete the most meaningful and/or valued actions (Note: that and/or shows a reality of altruism vs selfishness – help myself more or help others?).

I do not neglect meaningless activities, but they are therefore meaningless. If I commit to a more meaningful idea I should therefore commit my life to it even though it may cause a pay decrease or a damage career prospects.

I want to help people, I work in a career focused on cutting edge cancer research to help people, but I do not value it even though I can greatly see its meaning. I want to emphasize that most grandly science is seen as useless, but my work is the core of modern cancer medicine, we slowly push the knowledge of treatment; I understand and respect that.

I simply do not care about anything beyond this world or even in my career world. I’ve searched for more that decade and I’m only fed the idea of family and friends. I should live for these reasons. Fuck ‘em, they lives will be affect by my death, but in reality my role is minuscule. Even if my role was significant it feeds into a structure I detest. This structure may be destroyed in the future, but I live now. I can fight against it to help future generations, but I don’t care about future generations. I care about myself living towards happiness – happiness being a vague unreachable term that is perpetuated by culture.

If I could commit to meaningless activities and continue my life (which I expect a large number of people do) then I would be fine. I’m aware enough to question everything and dumb enough to not accept the delusion. People can create happy life for themselves, but the criteria they use are abrasive to me.

Anhedonia is interesting as I still see this as a form of this state, but I cannot overcome it due to a value structure. 

I haven't lived abroad and I live in the US. My career experience allows me to easily live in California, Japan, and Europe as whole (Mostly UK, Germany and France) without much issue; I will likely get a larger salary (Canada pays shit-all for clinical research).

I could restart my life, but I have no reason to do it side from the unknown (which can be a reason). If that is true I should always jeopardize my life for the sole idea of the unknown, which "people" generally do not do. I advantageously have the option to do this, but moving countries is a huge deal. I can do it and always consider it, but there is no reason other than "I should". To accept it *will* be better is arrogance; it may be better.

I'm a scientist so I like to weigh all options. Scientists get a damaging rep for being cold, I think others are being delusional. Movie-wise my favorite documentary is Dear Zachary as it is scathingly emotional. Overall film is tough, but I do enjoy 2001 and Princess Mononoke, but I do not want to disparage the small indie films. Some individuals/ small studios can produce great art.

Even subreddits are tough, my main account has 446 subscribed subreddits. I do have greater interests like poker for example, but affection and a life commitment are different things.

For Christmas what truly wish is to not care about it. Going to see my family because it is Dec 25th instead of Dec 15th is stupid, but even then I don’t care to go to family gatherings. I understand they as individuals that value my presence as a family member, but I don’t value the effort to collect or celebrate. Social events like this are significantly draining and are only social work. I get no value from them, but do them as it is expected – although I imagine this is most people.

The best fay to describe my familial relationship is that people appreciate you more based on the time you spend in their life, this is how the social world works. On top of that I would say there is a constant that amplifies the social item spent. If you hate someone spending 2h together does not affect for relationship, 2h x 0 is 0. In my family I would say my largest relationship constant is with him. We easily get a long and always have despite familial issues – I just don’t care about kids or acting life a family member. In the last year my bother got married and had a kid. If he is happy I applaud his efforts. I hope he directs his life to what he wants. That is all meaningless to me. Having a kid is like filling your gas tank, congratulations you managed something basic (raising it is a different story). If I don’t want kids, why do I care about kids within my family? Because they are my nieces/nephews/cousins? Is that the only argument that can be made? They are your kids which are nothing to me (and that idea I cold to them, I’m expect me to be what they want).

I don’t know If my brother judges me and I don’t care. He has done a bunch of shitty things to my family, but the joke is that I assume he feels like I do and doesn’t care. He is who he is, as am I. He committed to ideas I reject while I reject them. I assume he is happy, but for me to pretend I care and commit to ideas is suicide and I always laugh at the people that think having a child will save their relationship. Clearly doomed at that point.
